name: Lavice
source:
The egoistic ojousama who believes she is the most beautiful thing in this world.
Maya Union's former assassination target with a priority number of 1666, she's the object of admiration to many of their elders now. With her silver colored twintail, crimson eyes and her mysterious nature she captures the heart of the people who see her.
If you express their thoughts about her in words "She is more majestic than gods and more beautiful than the world."
Rumor has it that she managed to reach the top of the organization not by seizing the elders' weakness but by seizing their crotch, thus earning her the nickname "Fellatio Princess".
She belongs to the Special Peace corps, despite the rumor that she's not very strong and that she doesn't work much.
It seems she believes that the world revolves around her. She always carries a fan around, and refers to herself with "Lavi".

[Edited from a [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/06/16/edensaishuusensoushoujodensetsu/]preview[/url] by Warum]
